legal.privacyReplayBody: Replay uses fixed sample data. It sets no cookies and writes nothing to local storage, session storage, IndexedDB, or Cache Storage.
legal.privacyOwnerBody: When the owner signs in to provider settings, the app sets two Secure, SameSite Strict cookies for up to 15 minutes. The signed session cookie is HttpOnly. This page can read the CSRF cookie only when it protects a settings request.
legal.privacyKeyBody: The provider key is sent to the server, encrypted there, and never returned by the settings service. alphadecay does not save it in browser storage.
legal.privacyFlowBody: When the private agent runs, a limited evidence set is sent to the provider chosen by the owner. That provider handles the request under its own terms and privacy policy.
legal.importantPaperBody: alphadecay supports Alpaca paper trading only. Replay cannot reach an account or send an order. Paper fills do not reproduce every condition of live trading.
legal.importantAdviceBody: alphadecay is a hackathon prototype, not investment advice, a recommendation, or a brokerage service. Options can lose money, and no Replay or paper result promises future performance.
legal.importantModelBody: The selected model reviews a limited evidence set. Application rules still decide what is allowed and stop when required information is missing or uncertain.

THESIS_INTACT.name: Thesis intact
THESIS_INTACT.summary: The reason for the trade still matches its direction, time, and volatility exposure.
THESIS_INTACT.decision: Hold the paper position and check it again at the next scheduled boundary.

THETA_TAKEOVER.name: Time decay takes over
THETA_TAKEOVER.summary: The direction still makes sense, but daily time decay now outweighs the remaining upside.
THETA_TAKEOVER.decision: A later expiry reduces time pressure without adding uncovered risk.

CATALYST_BROKEN.name: Catalyst broken
CATALYST_BROKEN.summary: The latest sample update contradicts the event that supported the trade.
CATALYST_BROKEN.answer: The opening reason no longer holds.
CATALYST_BROKEN.decision: Close is the only allowed choice once the sample catalyst is invalidated.

STALE_QUOTE.name: Stale quote
STALE_QUOTE.summary: The option quote is 45 seconds old. The freshness limit is 30 seconds.
STALE_QUOTE.answer: The quote is too old to assess.
STALE_QUOTE.decision: No action is chosen until a fresh quote passes the gate.

exposure.title: Exposure from intent to outcome
exposure.intro: The planned position, the measured mismatch, and the result a broker would have to confirm stay separate.
exposure.intendedValue: Bullish exposure, enough time for the move, and loss capped by the spread.
exposure.noBrokerOutcomeDetail: No order was sent, so there is no fill or position after the action to reconcile.

thesis.title: Frozen thesis
thesis.comparisonIntro: The left side is the promise made before entry. The right side is what the option spread measures now.
thesis.fullHorizon: Enough time remains for the move
thesis.definedRisk: Loss stays inside the fixed limit
thesis.noContradiction: The sample update does not break the catalyst
thesis.deltaHelp: Delta estimates how much the spread changes when the stock moves by one dollar.
thesis.thetaHelp: Theta is the estimated dollar cost of one calendar day passing.
thesis.vegaHelp: Vega estimates the dollar change from a one percentage-point move in implied volatility.

drift.title: Where the mismatch came from
drift.scale: Contribution score: 0–100. Higher means more drift.

run.title: Run log
run.intro: Replay verifies the sample facts and their hashes, then runs the decision policy. Provider calls and order entry are off.
run.technologyTitle: Production integrations · not run in Replay
run.observe: Load the sample and verify its hash
run.validate: Verify the sample shape and hash
run.compare: Run hold, close, and roll policy
run.liveRegion: Replay check complete. The decision record is ready.

alternatives.title: Choices checked
alternatives.intro: The policy scores every allowed choice. A rejected choice stays in the record.
alternatives.blockedIntro: The record keeps every allowed choice, including choices the policy could not assess.
alternatives.holdAligned: The position still matches the frozen plan.
alternatives.holdTheta: Holding leaves too little time for the planned move.
alternatives.holdBroken: Holding is not allowed after the catalyst is invalidated.
alternatives.closeTheta: A close is safe, but a bounded roll preserves the valid direction.
alternatives.closeBroken: The catalyst gate requires a close.
alternatives.rollAligned: A roll adds cost without fixing a mismatch.
alternatives.rollTheta: The replacement restores time while keeping a defined loss.
alternatives.rollBroken: A roll cannot repair a broken reason for owning the trade.
alternatives.holdStale: Hold is not assessed from an old quote.
alternatives.closeStale: Close is not assessed from an old quote.
alternatives.rollStale: Roll is not assessed from an old quote.

certificate.title: Joined decision record
certificate.intro: The assessment and execution records stay separate. A result checked against the broker belongs only in the second record.
certificate.expectedClose: No option position after a checked close
certificate.expectedRoll: A later expiry with risk limited by the spread
certificate.expectedBlocked: Not calculated while the quote is stale.
certificate.notApplicable: No order or fill exists to reconcile.
certificate.details: The record links the saved thesis, measured exposure, alternatives, policy result, and order status. Hashes are shortened for this public sample.
certificate.limitations: Scenario replay proves the product flow, not market fills or trading profit.

assignment.heading: The position may have changed through assignment.
assignment.body: Orders stay blocked until every option leg and unexpected share is reconciled.
